people.name: Assyria
people.line: A powerful ancient empire, often in conflict with Israel.

people.name: Menahem
people.line: King of Israel who reigned for ten years.

people.name: Tiglath-pileser
people.line: Assyrian king who conquered parts of Israel

translations.web: Pul the king of Assyria came against the land, and Menahem gave Pul one thousand talents of silver, that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand.
translations.bsb: Then Pul king of Assyria invaded the land, and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver in order to gain his support and strengthen his own grip on the kingdom.
translations.kjv: And Pul the king of Assyria came against the land: and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver, that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand.
translations.asv: There came against the land Pul the king of Assyria; and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver, that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand.
